findings.highlight: The wound on my shoulder is swelling up
findings.evidenceJa: 肩の傷は赤く腫れ上がり
findings.explanation: The visible redness of Shirou’s worsening wound disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識が曖昧になっていく
findings.explanation: A failing state of consciousness is reduced to unclear thoughts.

findings.highlight: only when my enemy is someone else
findings.evidenceJa: 相手が他人の場合だけ
findings.governingReading: only when the other party is someone else
findings.explanation: Shirou’s contrast between losing to another person and losing to himself is recast as an enemy comparison.

findings.highlight: I grab it with my left hand
findings.evidenceJa: それを右手で押さえつけて
findings.governingReading: he presses it down with his right hand
findings.explanation: The hand used in the physical action is reversed.

findings.highlight: there is nothing wrong with the path I took
findings.evidenceJa: この道に間違いはない
findings.governingReading: there is nothing wrong with this path
findings.explanation: Shirou’s continuing commitment is shifted into a path framed as already taken.

findings.highlight: What needs to be done is determined from the start
findings.evidenceJa: やるべき事は最初から決まっていた
findings.governingReading: what I had to do had been settled from the beginning
findings.explanation: The English produces malformed tense and weakens Shirou’s retrospective realization.

findings.highlight: repay her for what she did that night
findings.evidenceJa: あの夜の借りを返さないと
findings.governingReading: repay the debt I owe her from that night
findings.explanation: The life-debt motif is weakened into an unspecified thing Rin did.
